source.download_method: Official data.gov.sg public dataset download API; GeoJSON
source.source_vintage: HPB records include FMEL_UPD_D values dated 2024-11-29; dataset page describes data from Nov 2024 and last updated 2026-01-04
source.license: Singapore Open Data Licence v1.0; free reuse including commercial use with attribution
source.attribution: Health Promotion Board (HPB), Singapore; dataset: Healthier Eateries, accessed 2026-10-18

matching.algorithm: Only workbook records with both Latitude and Longitude blank. Require exact six-digit postal equality, then normalize workbook Full Address and HPB ADDRESSBLOCKHOUSENUMBER + ADDRESSSTREETNAME and require the HPB street line as a contiguous substring in the normalized workbook address. Require one unique coordinate among street-line matching source features for that postal.
matching.normalization: Uppercase Unicode normalization; strip punctuation, Singapore/postal text, unit, floor, block labels; retain house number and street name.
matching.precision: Building/facility/address point from HPB point layer; repeated across multiple tenants in the same complex; not verified outlet, unit, or stall-front position.
matching.recommendation: Candidate only. If retained, store with explicit source attribution, source date, and building/facility precision label. Do not label as exact outlet coordinate without independent unit/outlet evidence.
